svg.data-power-input: 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, per supply (the 800 W supply also 230-240 VDC)
svg.data-fans: six 40 x 40 x 56 mm counter-rotating fans
svg.data-cpu: one 4th or 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processor, socket E (LGA-4677), 85 to 350 W TDP (over 205 W only under specific conditions)
svg.data-memory: 8 DDR5 DIMM slots, up to 2 TB of 5600 MT/s ECC RDIMM
svg.data-storage: two internal fixed 2.5 inch SATA bays; one M.2 PCIe 3.0 x2 NVMe slot
svg.data-regulatory: FCC, ICES, CE, UKCA, VCCI, RCM, NRTL, CB
